economics.rules.cash_flow_outside_horizo: Line {ref} runs to year {year_to}, beyond the horizon of {horizon} years; the money after it is ignored.
Shorten the line or extend the horizon.

Correct the years of the line.
economics.rules.committed_over_frame.fai: Commitments on {ref} are {committed}, above its frame of {frame}.
economics.rules.committed_over_frame.sug: Raise the frame line through the change process, or release the commitment.
economics.rules.committed_unassigned.fai: Commitments of {amount} sit under no frame line.
economics.rules.committed_unassigned.sug: Add a frame line for their code, or give their cost lines a control account.
economics.rules.committed_unknown.fail: The project has no cost lines, so commitments cannot be attributed to the frame.
economics.rules.committed_unknown.sugges: Generate the cost spine from the bill.
economics.rules.currency_mismatch.fail: The plan is in {plan} but the bill is in {bill}.
economics.rules.currency_mismatch.sugges: Set the plan currency to the bill's, or convert the bill.
economics.rules.discount_rate_missing.fa: No discount rate is set, so the present value of the business case cannot be computed.
economics.rules.discount_rate_missing.su: Enter the discount rate in percent per year.
economics.rules.estimate_over_frame.fail: The estimate of {ref} is {estimate}, above its frame of {frame}.
economics.rules.estimate_over_frame.sugg: Raise the frame line or bring the estimate down.
economics.rules.estimate_unassigned.fail: {count} estimate lines sit under no frame line or carry no code, so they are not compared.
economics.rules.estimate_unassigned.sugg: Add a frame line for their code, or code the lines of the bill.
economics.rules.financing_shortfall.fail: The sources leave {shortfall} of the requirement of {requirement} uncovered.
economics.rules.financing_shortfall.sugg: Add a source or raise an existing one.
economics.rules.frame_empty.fail: The cost frame has no lines.
economics.rules.frame_empty.suggestion: Add frame lines by hand or generate them from the codes of the bill.
economics.rules.frame_lines_overlap.fail: Frame line {ref} contains frame line {other}, so the same cost would be counted twice.
economics.rules.frame_lines_overlap.sugg: Keep one of the two codes, or split the broader one into the codes below it.
economics.rules.frame_zero_amount.sugges: Enter the budget of the line.
economics.rules.grant_over_award.fail: Source {ref} is {basis} at {award} by its application and is entered higher.
economics.rules.grant_over_award.suggest: Lower the source to the amount of the application.
economics.rules.grant_without_applicatio: Source {ref} is a grant or subsidy without a funding application.
Link the application of the funding module.
economics.rules.insurance_expired.fail: Insurance {ref} ended on {period_to} and is not renewed.
economics.rules.insurance_expired.sugges: Renew the policy or record the new period.
economics.rules.investment_below_frame.f: The investment of {investment} is below the cost frame of {frame}.
economics.rules.investment_below_frame.s: Link the investment line to the cost frame or raise the investment.
economics.rules.markups_over_allowance.f: The markups of the bill are {markups}, above the allowance of the cost frame.
economics.rules.markups_over_allowance.s: Raise the allowance for markups, taxes and reserves.
economics.rules.no_benefit.fail: The business case has no revenue or residual value, so nothing returns the investment.
economics.rules.no_benefit.suggestion: Add the revenues or benefits the project is expected to produce.
economics.rules.no_bill.fail: The project has no bill of quantities, so there is no estimate to compare the frame with.
economics.rules.no_bill.suggestion: Create the bill, or read the estimate from another bill.
economics.rules.no_investment.fail: The business case has no investment.
economics.rules.no_investment.suggestion: Add an investment line, or link it to the cost frame.
economics.rules.no_sources.fail: No source of finance is entered.
economics.rules.no_sources.suggestion: Add the equity, loans and grants that fund the investment.
economics.rules.process_not_set_up.fail: The process {ref} is not set up.
economics.rules.process_not_set_up.sugge: Describe the process, name its owner and mark it as set up.
economics.rules.security_expired.fail: Security {ref} ran out on {valid_until} and is not renewed.
economics.rules.security_expired.suggest: Renew the security or mark it as released.
economics.rules.several_bills.fail: The project has {bills} bills; the estimate is read from one of them only.
economics.rules.several_bills.suggestion: Choose the bill the estimate is read from.
Source {ref} has no tranches, so its timing is unknown.
Plan when the money is drawn.

economics.rules.tax_not_confirmed.sugges: Record the treatment and confirm it with the tax adviser.
